name: Veil Masquerade #15
description: A cloth figure for Veil: a crowned mask over layered, patterned cloth falling to an uneven hem. Crown: Pyramid. Aperture: Twin slits. Ornament: Lattice. Palette: Gold. Hem: Straight. Its hem is shared with one other in the set of 20. No face — where the cloth is open, it is cloth removed rather than features drawn on.
